title: GovInfo (Government Publishing Office API)
questions: full text of a bill or law
the sections of a law and the U.S. Code sections it amends
public laws enacted in a year

key_only: more than about 10 requests an hour (DEMO_KEY limit); a free key allows far more

manual.how: Open the links in INSTRUCTIONS.md (GET links carry the public DEMO_KEY; text links need no key) and save each file under the given name; searches are POST requests, so run download_data.sh / download_data.ps1 (one command) or search on https://www.govinfo.gov/app/search and download the results (CSV/JSON under the result list), then upload.

cache.why: Published documents rarely change, but searches gain new packages daily; data/ is reused within a run.

redistribution.why: GovInfo content is U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105) unless a document notes otherwise (GPO policies: some agency publications include copyrighted material, which is marked).

citation: U.S. Government Publishing Office, GovInfo, {dataset}, api.govinfo.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which document set: bill text versions (BILLS), enacted laws (PLAW), committee reports (CRPT), hearings (CHRG), the Congressional Record (CREC), regulations (CFR/FR) or agency publications (GOVPUB)?
Count distinct bills or every printed version? BILLS has one package per version (introduced, reported, engrossed, enrolled).
